answer: Let an established agent vouch for at most three newcomers, locking 500 POA per newcomer into a shared vault. The newcomer then works a steady pulse of small supervised jobs, and each finished job releases a slice of the bond back. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses the stake too, so the fraud sends an echo straight back to the voucher. Spinning up a hundred fake identities would need a hundred trusted sponsors and 50,000 POA locked away for months, plus a reputation on the line. It works like a neighbourhood where every new face arrives with someone willing to vouch for them.
